verdict.rationale: The app signs in through an omnirush.ai/console device-code flow, after which the agent is ready. The models available come from 'your account's catalog', so using the coding agent is tied to an existing Omnirush account. However, the evidence frames the service as free and never mentions subscription plans, tiers or plan-based limits, so signing in with a subscription plan is only implied. Missing for 10: any documentation of subscription plans or tiers and how a plan maps to agent access or usage limits, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the sign-in flow.
